orgName: Qatar Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (France Galop)

source.name: France Galop - Our Partners (QREC)
source.note: 'Since 2008, the Qatar Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe and 14 other Group races in France have been under its banner'; the Arc is 'the world's richest turf race, worth EUR 5 million'. QREC also sponsors the Qatar Arabian World Cup 'since 2014', now EUR 1m.

note: 2026 edition confirmed as 'Qatar Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe', 3-4 Oct 2026, with 'QREC official partner' on France Galop's ticketing page (billetterie.france-galop.com). Reported 2023-2027 extension is a search-result claim, not verified in a fetched source. Fee not published.
